AiJudge._VisionEnabled_note: Shows the judge a screenshot of each rendered page as well as its source. Needs headless Chromium — already installed here for the E2E-UI suite. Off in appsettings.json because the Free-tier App Service has no browser. The judge deployment must accept image input.

Limits._note: Loose locally: the E2E-UI suite drives this one instance as a single guest.
